add_model_to_interface: add a PyTorch model to a ModelInterface with an Adam optimizer and optional CUDA placement
clone_model_interface: clone a ModelInterface including all models and optimizers to a specified GPU device
update_model_weights: update model weights by calling optimizer step and incrementing the model step counter
average_model_parameters: average the parameters between two models and update the target model in the interface
copy_model_between_keys: deep copy a model from one key to another key within the same ModelInterface
